title: Weak and strong normalization in pure type systems
summary: We prove that every weakly β -normalizing pure type system is strongly β -normalizing. Both properties quantify over all legal expressions in all valid contexts, and reduction acts inside type annotations. No functionality hypothesis is required. This resolves the β -Barendregt–Geuvers–Klop conjecture.
family_title: Weak normalization implies strong normalization in pure type systems

review.reason: Proves weak beta-normalization implies strong beta-normalization for pure type systems.
